inclusions.source: The hotel transfer is private to your party; the quad-bike ride, village visit, and BBQ dinner are shared with other guests at the desert camp.

inclusions.text: Guide pickup from your Hurghada hotel
inclusions.source: Your guide collects you from your Hurghada hotel and drives you to the quad bike station at the edge of the desert — a short transfer, typically 20 to 30 minutes depending on where you are staying.

inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person
inclusions.source: The outing takes bookings from a single person upward, with no minimum group, and one bottle of mineral water per person is provided.
At the station, you receive a helmet and safety equipment, and a briefing covers the controls and the route ahead.

inclusions.text: BBQ dinner (grilled meats, bread, soft drinks, mineral water)
inclusions.source: As the sky darkens, a BBQ dinner is set out — grilled meats, bread, soft drinks, and mineral water.
